name: @wafers/content
description: Authored game content: optimized glTF props and JSON game configuration

scripts.assets:reauthor: node scripts/extract-source-textures.mjs .tmp-src-tex && python3 scripts/reauthor-textures.py --from-dir .tmp-src-tex --out textures --size 1024 && node scripts/embed-reauthored.mjs
scripts.assets:reauthor:foup: node scripts/extract-source-textures.mjs .tmp-src-tex && python3 scripts/reauthor-textures.py --from-dir .tmp-src-tex --out textures --size 1024 --props Foup && node scripts/embed-reauthored.mjs --props Foup
scripts.assets:reauthor:foup-mesh: blender -b -P scripts/reauthor-foup-mesh.py -- --out .tmp-reauthor/Foup.glb --tex-out textures/Foup --size 1024 && node scripts/embed-reauthored.mjs --props Foup --mesh-src=.tmp-reauthor/Foup.glb
